name: Clarifo
description:
Clarifo brings source-backed financial research directly into Claude.

Search annual reports, interim reports and SEC filings; retrieve financial statements, key metrics, segment and geographic data; compare companies and reporting periods; screen listed companies; and run forecasting, valuation and reporting-standard research workflows.

Clarifo covers listed companies in the United States, Finland and Sweden, with more markets being added over time. Results are designed for financial analysis and include source-linked evidence so users can trace figures and claims back to the underlying filing.

Use Clarifo to:
• research companies and reported performance
• compare peers, quarters and multi-year trends
• analyze revenue, profitability, cash flow, segments and geography
• search risk factors, strategy, governance and disclosures
• investigate IFRS, US GAAP and local reporting questions
• build due-diligence briefs, valuation scenarios and visual summaries

Clarifo is read-only: it retrieves and analyzes information but does not modify user data or external systems. Access requires a Clarifo account and an eligible subscription or trial.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Clarifo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Clarifo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.clarifo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Clarifo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clarifo lists 40 MCP tools, including answer_reporting_standards, company_events, compare_companies, dd_quickscan, detect_inflection_points, discover_companies, document_summary, forecast_financials, generate_visual_cards, get_ceo_barometer, get_company_financials, and get_company_profile.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Clarifo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Clarifo in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Clarifo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Clarifo is developed by Clarifo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
